verdict_semantics.SEPARATING: advantage CI excludes zero + gap>=threshold for >=2 opponents
verdict_semantics.FLAT: coverage OK but no reliable advantage separation — V(context) cannot absorb return variance, or latents have equal value given context
verdict_semantics.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: replay coverage too weak to judge
verdict_semantics.INVALID: zero arcs / duplicate contamination / integrity failure

replay_validity.map_coverage: NOT_INSTRUMENTED (arc record carries no map_id; count_by_opponent x z is available instead)

heldout_gate.note: Do NOT promote on advantage spread alone.
